items.text: New York Giants (TBD): RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring), TE Theo Johnson (neck), S Jevon Holland and CB Greg Newsome II (concussions). QB Jaxson Dart (knee surgery) on IR, J.J. McCarthy starts; LB Brian Burns and LB Tremaine Edmunds out for season; RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR.

Philadelphia: QB Jalen Hurts (calf, blood clots) expected out for the season; Tanner McKee starts. TBD: WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring, did not play Monday), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), LB Jihaad Campbell (hamstring), CB Michael Carter II (abdomen); RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) in and out of Week 8.
items.source: Yahoo Sports NFL news live updates (Nov 2-3)
